item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 Quaternary ammonium lignin (QAL) in a gel polymer electrolyte simultaneously boosts Na⁺ conductivity and enables a NaF-rich SEI. QAL's electron-deficient groups anchor anions and aid NaTFSI dissociation, while its π-conjugated backbone supplies charge for TFSI⁻ decomposition. This yields 5000 h symmetric-cell cycling, 96.9% retention after 4700 cycles, and safe pouch cells under abuse from −20°C to 60°C, advancing high-safety sodium metal batteries.

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a radical passivation strategy using oxygen-rich species to passivate hydroxyl radicals, creating pseudographitic carbon microdomains with closed pores, expanded interlayer spacing, and C═O functionalities. This enables high sodium storage: 354.7 mAh g⁻¹, 85.8% initial Coulombic efficiency, and excellent cycling. It offers a design insight for regulating hard carbon architecture toward advanced sodium-ion batteries.
